ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Government Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate government spending and contracts to identify potential fraud and abuse
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What government programs are most vulnerable to fraud?
How can we increase transparency and accountability in government spending?
ideas.insight: By analyzing government spending and contracts, we can identify patterns and anomalies that may indicate fraud or abuse. This investigation could lead to significant recoveries and improved oversight.
